description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy and correlation values for three different metrics—Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy—across four models: Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The horizontal axis represents the model names, listed in the order Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For each model, there are three bars representing the three metrics; Sentiment Accuracy is represented by a peach-colored bar, STS Correlation by a light blue bar, and Paraphrase Accuracy by a light red bar. For the Single-task_baseline model, the Sentiment Accuracy bar reaches approximately 0.48, the STS Correlation bar reaches approximately 0.62, and the Paraphrase Accuracy bar reaches approximately 0.55. In the 2-Tier SimCSE model, the Sentiment Accuracy bar reaches approximately 0.76, the STS Correlation bar reaches approximately 0.78, and the Paraphrase Accuracy bar reaches approximately 0.72. The bars are grouped by model, with each metric represented by a different color within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
